PROCESS CONTROL TABLES - AIR & WATER SERVICES (F24)

Include a graphic to select lead, lag and standby duty for the air compressors (F24-CM-401, F24-CM-402, F24-CM-403):

DUTY LEAD
DUTY LAG
STANDBY

IF 2x STANDBY Compressors are selected, THEN the remaining Compressor must be DUTY LEAD.
Note that normal configuration for the compressors operate with  1 Lead, 1 Lag, and 1 Standby unit.

Duty Selection for compressors will enable the following output signal/status:
F24-CM-401:
IF DUTY LEAD is selected THEN HS24497REM Activated AND HS24466LD ON
IF DUTY LAG is selected THEN HS24497REM Activated, HS24466LD OFF
IF STANDBY is selected THEN HS24497REM Activated

Remote START/STOP command HS24467STT is available to start/stop the compressor

F24-CM-402:
IF DUTY LEAD is selected THEN HS24498REM Activated AND HS24473LD ON
IF DUTY LAG is selected THEN HS24498REM Activated AND HS24473LD OFF
IF STANDBY is selected THEN HS24498REM Activated 

Remote START/STOP command HS24474STT is available to start/stop the compressor.

F24-CM-403:
IF DUTY LEAD is selected THEN HS24499REM Activated AND HS24485LD ON
IF DUTY LAG is selected THEN HS24499REM Activated, HS24485LD OFF
IF STANDBY is selected THEN HS24499REM Activated

Remote START/STOP command HS24486STT is available to start/stop the compressor

STANDBY compressors when started will be re-assigned as DUTY LEAD OR DUTY LAG and will follow the above output signals 

The Atlas Copco PLC will control the pressure setpoint that the compressors run to.

See Digital Outputs sheet for further details.
